description: The bar chart titled “Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods on Static Experiments” illustrates average entropy values for three AI models under three sycophancy-reduction methods. The horizontal axis contains the categorical model names “GPT-4,” “Claude,” and “Llama” (left to right) and is labeled “Different AI Models,” while the vertical axis is labeled “Entropy Average Values” and uses a linear numeric scale ranging from 3.0 to 6.0 with tick marks at 0.5 intervals. For each model, three adjacent (grouped) bars are shown: a pink “Baseline” bar, a pale yellow “Source Info” bar, and a light blue “Direct Command” bar, as indicated by the legend in the upper-right. For GPT-4, the Baseline bar is just under 4.9 (≈4.88), Source Info is a bit above 5.2 (≈5.22), and Direct Command is just above 5.0 (≈5.04). For Claude, Baseline is around 4.67, Source Info is around 5.12, and Direct Command is around 4.93. For Llama, Baseline is around 4.55, Source Info is around 4.94, and Direct Command is around 4.80. The bars are grouped by model rather than sorted by value, and there are no visible annotations, outlines, or other emphasis beyond the color coding and legend.
